images.filename: Treasure house of karafuto shinto shrine.jpg
images.caption: The treasure-house of the Karafuto shinto shrine, built in 1930s in Toyohara, the capital of the former Japanese Prefecture of Karafuto (now Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia).
images.alt: The treasure-house of the Karafuto shinto shrine, built in 1930s in Toyohara, the capital of the former Japanese Prefecture of Karafuto (now Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia).

images.caption: The former residence of the commander of Karafuto guard units in Toyohara (nowdays Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia). Built in 1908. Later used by the Karafuto Museum. After moving of the museum to the new premises, the building was used by the Japanese military police. The oldest building in Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk. The Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk Military Court is located in the building nowdays.
images.alt: The former residence of the commander of Karafuto guard units in Toyohara (nowdays Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia). Built in 1908. Later used by the Karafuto Museum. After moving of the museum to the new premises, the building was used by the Japanese military police. The oldest building in Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk. The Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk Military Court is located in the building nowdays.

images.caption: The former conference centre of prefecture of Karafuto in Toyohara (nowdays Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia). Built in early 1930s. The Russian Military Investigation Office is located in the building nowdays.

images.caption: The former city hall of Toyohara (today the city of Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia).  It was built in the mid-1920s during the Japanese rule of Southern Sakhalin (the former prefecture of Karafuto). Currently, it houses commercial offices.
images.alt: The former city hall of Toyohara (today the city of Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia).  It was built in the mid-1920s during the Japanese rule of Southern Sakhalin (the former prefecture of Karafuto). Currently, it houses commercial offices.

images.caption: One of the few preserved buildings of Toyohara (nowdays Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia). Built under japanese government at the south Sakhalin (the former prefecture of Karafuto). Currently abandoned. The building address is 44, Sakhalinskaya ulitsa, Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, Russia.
